name: ddmarketer
description: Search validated SaaS opportunities mined from real user complaints across 8 public sources and scored 0-100 for commercial intent, and validate an idea you already have against the corpus.

http.description: Use hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (no install). Optional 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' unlocks get_dossier.

examples.title: Find validated gaps in a market
examples.description: Search the complaint corpus by keyword
examples.prompt: Use ddmarketer to find validated SaaS gaps around shopify accounting, and tell me which has the highest commercial intent.

examples.title: Validate an idea you already have
examples.description: Score an idea against real complaints
examples.prompt: I want to build a tool that reconciles Shopify payouts with accounting software. Use ddmarketer's validate_idea to check whether there is real demand.
